verdict.rationale: Postmark is an API-first email service, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question to ask. However, the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no doc in the pack mentions a published spec. The llms.txt file (HTTP 200) is a prose endpoint summary for LLMs, not a machine-readable API specification equivalent to OpenAPI. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only standard paths.
